### Where Would I Go?
Author: Leslie Snyder
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/where-would-i-go-homeword-may-21.html
Passage: John 6:67-69
Points:
- Jesus gently probed the Twelve after a crowd of followers abandoned Him.
- Even dedicated and mature believers encounter seasons of doubt and spiritual uncertainty.
- Scripture shows that respected figures like David and John the Baptist openly wrestled with hard questions.
- God does not reject honest doubt; believers can safely bring their questions directly to Jesus.
- When facing uncertainty, Peter's confession reminds us that Christ alone holds the words of eternal life.

### Persevering Disciples
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/persevering-disciples
Passage: John 6:66-71
Points:
- Hard teachings separate superficial admirers from genuine followers of Christ.
- Peter recognized that leaving was impossible because Jesus alone is the source of eternal life.
- True disciples hold firmly to Christ even when their understanding of His ways remains incomplete.
- Outward association with Jesus does not guarantee authentic redemption, as shown by Judas Iscariot.
- God's people persevere in faith by consistently turning back to the Savior's life-giving words.
